# Michael Padin — Full-Stack Developer
> Available for freelance projects and full-time remote roles

Michael Padin is a full-stack web developer based in Cebu, Philippines (UTC+8),
specialising in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

## Skills
- Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js (App Router), TanStack, Tailwind CSS

- Cloud: AWS S3, Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Docker
- Tooling: Turborepo, pnpm workspaces, Git
